title: The Moonlight Banyan
description: Aarav and Meera race against time to find the glowing banyan tree that appears only under a full moon, hoping to make a wish for their village.

cast.name: Nanu
cast.role: gentle storyteller and keeper of village legends

scenes.description: wide shot of peaceful Indian village under twilight, children listening to elderly man tell stories, warm lantern light, storybook cozy style
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) peaceful Indian village under twilight, (children listening:1.3) to elderly man telling stories, warm lantern light, (storybook cozy:1.4)
scenes.narration: साँझ की लालिमा में, नानू ने एक रहस्य सुनाया—एक बरगद का पेड़, जो केवल पूर्णिमा की रात चाँदनी में जगमगाता है, और एक सच्चा मनोकामना पूरी करता है।
scenes.subtitle: The Legend

scenes.subtitle: Moonlit Run

scenes.subtitle: The Firefly Trail

scenes.subtitle: The Moonlight Banyan
